name: E02_1_crossway_troublemakers_attacking_vampires_get_deathtouch_and_lifelink
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink.' Seat 0's Vampire (1/1) and Bear (1/1, not a Vampire) attack; seat 1's two 0/9 Walls block one each. The Vampire is an attacking Vampire: its 1 damage is lethal to the 9-toughness Wall (deathtouch, Wall One dies) and gains seat 0 1 life (lifelink, 21). The Bear is not a Vampire: its 1 damage only marks Wall Two (damage 1, alive), no life. Troublemakers itself does not attack.
